mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_task (task_name, task_type, status, priority, timeout_seconds, input_content, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskName}, #{taskType}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{timeoutSeconds}, #{inputContent}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at ASC
